parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the pump, colored pink with a smooth matte finish, forming the upper and lower sections of the container.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal mechanism and potentially the fluid reservoir, providing structural integrity to the pump assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper can grasp the cylindrical body from the sides for stable manipulation.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic container walls are thin shells enclosing air or fluid volume.

parts.description: The main cylindrical body of the pump, colored pink with a smooth matte finish, forming the upper and lower sections of the container.

parts.name: label band

physics.Basic_description: A lighter pink band wrapping around the mid-section of the bottle, appearing as a label or grip texture area.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a visual label area or enhanced friction surface for gripping the bottle body.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped along with the main body, offering a slightly higher friction surface for the gripper fingers.
physics.reason: Thin sleeve or printed layer on the hollow bottle shell.

parts.description: A lighter pink band wrapping around the mid-section of the bottle, appearing as a label or grip texture area.

parts.name: neck threads

physics.Basic_description: The threaded neck region at the top of the bottle body, colored pink, designed to mate with the collar.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the pump collar to screw onto the bottle securely.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and functionally critical to grasp directly; avoid contact to prevent damage to threads.
physics.reason: Threaded neck is a thin-walled cylindrical extension of the bottle.

annotationMapping.method: unique scaled centroid (source volume uses thinwall_solid_tetra)

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: The yellow/orange ring component at the very top, featuring vertical ridges for grip.
physics.Functional_description: Screws onto the bottle neck to secure the pump head assembly in place.
physics.Grasped_description: The ridged surface provides excellent friction for a gripper to twist or hold the collar during assembly/disassembly.
physics.reason: Screw cap collars are thin-walled rings.

parts.description: The yellow/orange ring component at the very top, featuring vertical ridges for grip.
parts.function: Screws onto the bottle neck to secure the pump head assembly in place.

parts.name: collar knurl

physics.Basic_description: The textured, knurled outer surface of the yellow collar, designed for high friction.
physics.Functional_description: Provides tactile feedback and grip for the user's fingers to tighten or loosen the collar.
physics.Grasped_description: Ideal grasp point for rotational manipulation due to high friction texture.
physics.reason: Surface feature of the hollow collar shell.

parts.description: The textured, knurled outer surface of the yellow collar, designed for high friction.

parts.name: lock ring shell

physics.Basic_description: A thin magenta rod-like structure extending from the bottom, likely representing the dip tube connection or a locking pin in this simplified model.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the dip tube or acts as a guide within the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and fragile to grasp safely; avoid contact.
physics.reason: Appears as a thin solid rod or pin in the visualization.

parts.name: head shell

physics.Basic_description: The cyan curved nozzle/spout extending from the side of the pump head.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the dispensed fluid away from the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped gently, but care must be taken not to snap the thin cantilevered structure.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow tubes to allow fluid flow.

parts.description: The cyan curved nozzle/spout extending from the side of the pump head.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: The long thin magenta tube extending from the bottom of the pump assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Draws fluid from the bottom of the container up to the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible and thin; should not be grasped as it may bend or detach.
physics.reason: Dip tubes are hollow pipes for fluid transport.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
